About us

About Refract.

What we believe

We believe that one of the most important experiences in learning is figuring something out for yourself.

01

Figuring it out

Figuring something out for yourself builds the belief that you can find your own way through the unfamiliar.

02

Learning to learn

Learning to learn is a fundamental capability. We want more people to have the confidence to pursue their own questions.

03

Why now

The world is changing fast, yet most learning still means following instructions to expected answers. We believe this needs to change.

04

What we do

We help educators, parents and organisations support learners without taking over their learning.

05

How we work

Grounded in the learning sciences: observe closely, ask questions, offer perspective, and leave room for the learner's own judgement.

06

For life

Self-directed learning matters throughout life. Refract exists to help make this possible.

Our vision

A world where people are more confident in their ability to ask questions, exercise judgement and figure things out for themselves.

Our mission

To enable individuals to thrive as self-directed learners who believe in themselves and take the actions needed to figure things out, by equipping educators, facilitators, parents and organisations to make room for curiosity, uncertainty and demanding learning journeys.

Team

Together they wrote Leaves in Pocket and started The Observation Project.

Our approach

Six skills of self-directed learning. Everything we make builds them.

Observation

Noticing what draws you, and looking closely.

Planning

Picking a direction and sketching a way in.

Inquiry

Testing, finding out, making something.

Self-monitoring

Watching yourself learn, and asking for help.

Reflection

Saying what you learned, and sharing it.

Self-efficacy

Believing you can. It grows every time you work something out.
